paragraphs.text: Entering the US market
Should Onsoo enter the US in 2027, and by which route? Discussion document for the CEO and board
Onsoo Botanicals
CEO and board
Synthetic benchmark data: company, competitors and figures are fictional

slides.title: Key questions

paragraphs.text: Key questions
Should Onsoo enter the US market in 2027, and if so by which route, within an $18M cash cap, payback by 2030 and an 8% group margin floor?
Is the US market large and open enough, and does the pilot show that Onsoo can sell there?
Does the Amazon-led route meet the board's cash, payback, margin and growth tests?
Is a national specialty-retail launch a better route to scale?
Is the US a better use of 2027 than a Japan scale-up?
What must happen, and when, to launch and to know that it is working?
Decision maker
Success criteria
Timing
Out of scope
CEO and board of Onsoo Botanicals

Cumulative US cash outflow of no more than $18M through 2030; Cumulative US cash back to zero by the end of 2030; Group operating margin at or above 8% in every year; A US business on the way to $40M of revenue by 2030; Only one major new-market launch in 2027
Board meeting, March 2027
Mass-retail or DTC-led entry; US acquisition or distributor; US and Japan launches together in 2027

slides.title: Executive summary

paragraphs.text: Executive summary
Enter the US in 2027 through Amazon, not national retail, and hold ad costs near the pilot's 28% so it pays back by 2030
The US is worth entering: K-beauty skincare nearly doubled to $3.6B, and Onsoo's Amazon test sells
–	61% of K-beauty buyers buy mostly on Amazon
–	Pilot sales nearly doubled in six months
Amazon-led entry fits the cash cap easily but pays back by 2030 only if ad costs stay near the pilot's
–	Payback needs ACoS of 28.6% or less
–	About $26M of revenue in 2030, not $40M
Retail-led entry fails the board's tests even on the planning team's own inputs
–	Newcomers like Onsoo sell 2.6 units a door a week
–	Cash outflow passes the $18M cap in 2029
A Japan scale-up is safer but adds only $7M of revenue in 2030, in a slow market
–	Japan pays back in 2029, with $1.8M by 2030
Launch on Amazon in 2027 under an ad-cost ceiling; add retail only once awareness passes 20%
–	Ambition restated: about $26M by 2030
